cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(POCKET_HOST_TEST)
    project(pocket_sdk_consumer C)
    enable_testing()
    find_package(Pocket REQUIRED CONFIG PATHS "${POCKET_SDK}/lib/cmake/Pocket" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
    add_library(quickjs STATIC "${POCKET_QUICKJS}/quickjs.c" "${POCKET_QUICKJS}/dtoa.c"
        "${POCKET_QUICKJS}/libregexp.c" "${POCKET_QUICKJS}/libunicode.c")
    target_include_directories(quickjs PUBLIC "${POCKET_QUICKJS}")
    target_compile_definitions(quickjs PRIVATE _GNU_SOURCE)
    target_link_libraries(quickjs PUBLIC m pthread)
    add_executable(consumer main/main.c consumer.c renderer.c hooks.c
        "${POCKET_SDK}/src/guest-quickjs/guest.c")
    target_include_directories(consumer PRIVATE . "${POCKET_SDK}/include/pocket")
    target_compile_options(consumer PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
    target_link_libraries(consumer PRIVATE Pocket::runtime quickjs)
    add_test(NAME sdk_consumer_host_mock COMMAND consumer)
else()
    include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)
    project(pocket_sdk_consumer)
endif()
